section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor analysis results for the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) conducted on a female subsample (n = 100). The analysis confirmed that all 10 BAS-2 items loaded onto a single factor explaining 61.4% of variance, with excellent internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha = .93). The section focuses on psychometric properties of the BAS-2 instrument rather than reporting demographic characteristics or correlations with BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 3.1.1 titled 'Female subsample' describing factor analysis and reliability of BAS-2.
